task.summary: App architecture mounted. Created load, home and consultation view. Created all models and persisted in the DB. Created controllers for the views.

Created views recipe.fxml, patient.fxml, and ingredient.fxml. Created controllers IngredientController, PatientController and RecipeController. Created IController to assign to controllers that opens panel over home.fxml Added new functionality to home.fxml and consultation.fxml

- Add persistence layer (repositories and services for consultations and patients) - Implement interactive calendar with right-click context menus - Create visual consultation cards with hover effects and deletion option - Integrate patient database save with field validations - Add hour/minute spinners to consultation form - Implement custom styles for context menus (new consultation and delete) - Fix card width overflow and event propagation issues - Update CHANGELOG with all modifications

Version 0.0.4-alpha. Implement CRUD functionality for ingredients and recipes; add ingredient and recipe list views with search capabilities; enhance patient detail and edit features. Added recipe details view.

Version 0.0.5-alpha. Enhance image handling and consultation detail view
- Added ImageLoader helper class for robust image loading and validation - Implemented format validation for patient photo selection in PatientController - Improved error handling and logging for image loading in PatientDetailController - Created ConsultationDetailController for displaying consultation details - Updated FXML files for consultation detail view and modified existing views for better image handling - Enhanced user feedback for unsupported image formats
Version 0.0.6-alpha. Removed hardcoded fxml paths and replaced with constants from `UIConstants`.
